summary: Code-level verification of brand-scoped zero-out logic in ProductExcelImport.tsx. Admin UI credentials not available, so per the review request, static code review was performed on the specific logic block (lines 590-616) plus UI labels/testids. Logic correctly filters zeroedOut to only include products whose brand appears in the uploaded Excel file, using normalized (lowercased/trimmed/space-collapsed) brand comparison. Simulation trace with the provided 3-product scenario produces the expected result (only p2 zeroed out; Casio product p3 untouched).
critical_code_review_comments: Logic at lines 590-616 is correct: brandsInFile Set is built from rows (Excel) + matched updated products, then the zero-out loop skips any product whose normalized brand is NOT in that Set. This correctly satisfies the requirement.
norm() at line 153 provides case-insensitive/whitespace-insensitive brand matching — good.
UI label at lines 1019-1028 clearly communicates the new brand-scoped behavior in Azerbaijani with a U.S. POLO ASSN. example. Preview subtitle at line 1261 also reflects this. Good UX.
Edge case (informational, not a bug): if a product in the DB has empty/undefined brand, it is intentionally skipped (line 611) — correct given the requirement.

Edge case (informational): brands are also added from matched updated products (lines 605-607). This is a safety net so that if the Excel matched a product via SKU/name but the brand column was blank in that row, the brand is still considered 'in file'. Reasonable defensive behavior.
test_credentials: No admin credentials available in /app/memory/test_credentials.md for the admin panel; UI-level test skipped as permitted by the review request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Change is a small logic tweak in /app/src/components/admin/ProductExcelImport.tsx lines 590-616 (brandsInFile Set filter). Simulation trace: products [p1 U.S.POLO stock5, p2 U.S.POLO stock10, p3 Casio stock3] + Excel row matching p1 with brand 'U.S. POLO ASSN.' produces zeroedOut=[p2] only. p3 (Casio) correctly excluded. UI shows brand scope in labels and preview subtitle. All required data-testids present.
